title: Paul Smith remote views the USS Stark attack

tellings.quote: I started describing this vessel, which reminded me of an American destroyer.

plain: Paul Smith, who served as a psychic spy in a government program that tried to see distant targets with the mind alone, a practice called remote viewing, says that in 1987 he described the attack on the USS Stark in the Persian Gulf during the Iran-Iraq War. He tells Michels, "I started describing this vessel, which reminded me of an American destroyer," in a session tied to his colleague Skip Atwater, and he links it to Washington Post coverage of the attack. If true, it would mean he perceived a real military event from far away.
